name: cursor-history
author: lumine-code
description: Navigate backward and forward through recent cursor positions.
backgroundTips: Return to an earlier cursor position with {{ 'cursor-history:prev' | keystroke }}
Move forward through cursor history with {{ 'cursor-history:next' | keystroke }}

max.title: Maximum Entries
max.description: Maximum number of cursor positions to keep.

rowDeltaToRemember.title: Row Movement Threshold
rowDeltaToRemember.description: Save a position when the cursor moves farther than this many rows.

columnDeltaToRemember.title: Column Movement Threshold
columnDeltaToRemember.description: Save same-row movement when it exceeds this many columns.

excludeClosedBuffer.title: Exclude Closed Files
excludeClosedBuffer.description: Remove positions whose editor has been closed.

keepSingleEntryPerBuffer.title: One Entry per File
keepSingleEntryPerBuffer.description: Keep only the latest position for each file.

searchAllPanes.title: Search All Panes
searchAllPanes.description: Reuse an existing editor from any pane before opening another one.

openInPendingState.title: Open in Preview Mode
openInPendingState.description: Open closed history targets in pending state.

flashOnLand.title: Flash Destination Line
flashOnLand.description: Briefly highlight the destination after a jump.

ignoreCommands.title: Ignored Commands
ignoreCommands.description: Commands that must not create history entries.

debug.title: Debug Logging
debug.description: Print history changes to the developer console.
